details: Bitcoin slipped below the $84,000 mark on Wednesday, leading to approximately $487 million in leveraged long liquidations across the crypto market. The decline is attributed to rising oil prices, surging Treasury yields, and a strengthening U.S. dollar, pressuring overall risk appetite. Despite the dip, some analysts suggest Bitcoin retains a broader bullish stair-step pattern, with key support around $83,000 to $82,000.
title: Bitcoin Under Pressure, Dips Below $84,000 Amid Macro Headwinds

details: Ethereum experienced a notable 5.6% drop in the last 24 hours, falling to around $2,558 and breaking below a critical price channel. This decline has expanded weekly losses to nearly 6%. The second-largest cryptocurrency is also facing sustained pressure from US spot Ethereum ETF outflows, which saw funds shed roughly 21,432 ETH (approximately $58 million) on October 6, extending a multi-session outflow streak.
title: Ethereum Tumbles 5.6%, Spot ETFs See Continued Outflows

details: Financial brokerage firm Robinhood has announced its first-ever corporate Bitcoin acquisition, purchasing $25 million in BTC to add to its balance sheet. This strategic move signals Robinhood's bullish outlook on Bitcoin and marks a significant step towards integrating digital assets into its corporate treasury strategy, potentially setting a precedent for future crypto holdings by the company.
title: Robinhood Makes First Corporate Bitcoin Purchase of $25 Million

details: Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Bank of Kazakhstan (NBK) and the Alatau City Administration (ACA). This agreement aims to establish a framework for collaboration to explore opportunities in stablecoin applications, asset tokenization, and decentralized finance within Kazakhstan's regulatory environment.
title: Tether Explores Stablecoins and Asset Tokenization with Kazakhstan Central Bank

details: In a significant regulatory development, Winklevoss has filed for a Nasdaq-listed spot Zcash (ZEC) Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) under the ticker symbol WINK. This move could potentially open Zcash to a broader range of institutional and retail investors, similar to how Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETF filings have impacted their markets.
title: Winklevoss Files for Spot Zcash ETF

details: During its Sui Basecamp event, the Sui network recorded a groundbreaking live throughput of 40,614,180 transactions per second (TPS), a new world record independently verified by CertiK. This achievement demonstrates Sui's capacity to handle massive transaction volumes in real-time, positioning it to support the emerging agent economy.
title: Sui Network Achieves Record 40.6 Million Transactions Per Second (TPS)

details: Uniswap (UNI) has experienced a significant drop of over 9% in the last 24 hours, primarily due to a broader leveraged crypto risk-off move and market-wide liquidations rather than specific negative news related to the protocol. DeFi tokens, including UNI, were particularly affected as macroeconomic pressure and an over-leveraged market triggered a wave of long liquidations.
title: Uniswap (UNI) Drops 9% Amid Broad Crypto Liquidations
